To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
We developed a system that automa- tically collects, extracts metadata, and performs data analysis for spatio-temporal data, with a particular focus on Multiple Sclerosis ( MS) lesions.

1) we have created a spatio-temporal data management system that can manage, analyze and present data from multiple sources and modalities in a unified manner; 2) we have created an application for tracking MS lesions that is extensible to other applications; and 3) we have demonstrated that this system can be used to track the development of MS lesions over time.

1) a multi-modal data management system for MS data has been developed that provides a flexible framework for data integration and analysis, and 2) the system has been applied to a real-world data set and has been shown to be effective in the analysis and management of MS data.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the design, implementation and application of a spatio-temporal data management system for managing and analyzing MS data, and with the development of algorithms to extract and analyze the spatio-temporal information from the data.
the design of a data management and analysis system that is able to manage, analyze, visualize and correlate spatio-temporal multispectral MR images with other clinical data streams.

the management, integration and analysis of heterogeneous, spatio-temporal, multi-modal, and multi-resolution data, and the development of a framework that enables the integration of data management and analysis.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this system is a useful tool in the analysis of MS lesions and the management of patient data.
the current system is a useful tool that can be used for the management and analysis of multi-modal data.
the proposed system provides a comprehensive environment for managing and analyzing multi-modal spatio-temporal MS lesion data.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
it provides a platform to integrate and manage multiple types of data and perform analysis in a unified environment.
it is possible to create a system that can automatically extract the data from the various modalities, and perform the necessary analysis to produce a comprehensive summary.
we have developed a system that automizes the data collection, metadata generation, and analysis of spatiotemporal multi-modal data streams.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to build a system that can efficiently manage and analyze multi-modal data streams and can provide a platform for the development of new algorithms for the analysis of such data.
the system can be used to automate the collection, extraction of relevant metadata, and analysis of disparate streams of spatio-temporally correlated data.

the development of a spatio-temporal data analysis environment for a specific domain requires an understanding of the data, its sources, and the data management and analysis requirements of the domain experts.
